source: vanilla game paks via PakVirtualFS (prefab ancestry read), tools/cli measure, tmp/everon/raw/*.txt world dumps
caveats: everonWorldCount is null for Prefabs/Vehicles/* and Prefabs/Items/*: the world dump has 0 Prefabs/Vehicles rows (cannot tell if vehicles are absent from the map or skipped by the extractor).
everonWorldCount sums every variant matched by the entry's colour/variant family (see notes); structure rows are deduplicated by (path, round x, round z), C rows are summed as given.
sizeM is [width x, depth z, height y] of the model bounds at scale 1; null where the prefab is a composite entity with no MeshObject of its own.
hasAction/actions come from the resolved prefab ancestry text (ActionsManagerComponent and *Action classes); for entries where only the context exists the action class is marked unextracted.
No drivable boat or trailer prefab exists in vanilla: Prefabs/Vehicles/Water is empty and Wheeled holds no trailer.

items.name: Skoda S105 car (10 colours)
items.notes: Civilian saloon; colour = sibling prefab (beige, darkblue, darkbrown, darkred, green, lightblue, lightgreen, red, white, yellow). Used on the LF vehicle lot (locked child EL_S105_beige). _rally and _FIA variants are not civilian.

items.name: UAZ452 passenger van (civilian colours)

items.notes: SCR_FuelNozzle with InventoryItemComponent; child of the pump, can be placed alone as a dressing prop.

items.name: Fuel tank with pump housing (FuelTank_02_Pump)
items.notes: Grey, green, yellow, USSR variant. Scenery only: no SCR_FuelSupportStationComponent in its chain, so it does not refuel; pair with the pump prop.

items.name: Fuel tank, upright (FuelTank_03)
